_comment: The chapter's week-0 snapshot: the facts the store's sensors were built on before the world moved.
The simulated internet itself (pools, ASNs, feeds) is the W3 starter's data/world.json and data/feeds/*,
which the store's edge reads; this file adds only what DRIFTS in this chapter.
ja4: illustrative JA4 values, one per client stack, as captured in lab week 0 (capture real ones with the
tools from W2 Ch5). community_blocklist_stale: an old community-blocklist entry for a range that has since
changed hands (tools/refresh_corpus.py --asn retires it). built_week: when the snapshot was taken.
